sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Gold-Plated Multi-Color Stone Traditional Nath – Vibrant Ruby & Emerald Green
sourceNotes.rawContent: Add a festive pop of color with this exquisite gold-toned nath. Featuring a radiant mix of multi-colored stones, this high-fashion piece is a stunning ethnic statement. To maintain its brilliant golden luster, keep it away from moisture and perfumes, and store it safely in a dry place after use.
